description: Add supplier invoices to the book: raw emails with PDF attachments, PDFs (text or scanned), photos, or pasted text, up to 25 per call. Each is read, checked against its own printed total, given its job reference, kept with its original, and checked for price changes against earlier invoices from the same supplier. Duplicates are skipped. Returns one result per document: added, needs_check (did not add up, held back), duplicate or failed.

email.description: The whole email as exported (.eml or the raw source), including PDF attachments. Best option.

image_base64.description: A photo of a paper invoice (JPEG or PNG), base64.

job_reference.description: Only if the job reference is not on the invoice or the email subject.

pdf_base64.description: A PDF invoice, base64. Text PDFs and scanned PDFs both work.

supplier_name.description: Only if the supplier name is not on the invoice.

text.description: Invoice text, or several pasted emails separated by a line of ---.

name: add_supplier_invoices
title: Add supplier invoices (emails, PDFs, photos)
